## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what the proposed feature does.

## 🔬 Motivation & Biological Context
Is this biologically motivated (e.g. adding extrasynaptic neuromodulators like dopamine/serotonin, simulating muscles, testing sensory ablation)?

## 🛠️ Proposed Implementation
Explain how this could be architected within the `simulation/` or `game/` modules.

## 🎮 Game Impact
How does this change snake behavior, game dynamics, or dashboard visualizations?
